purpose: Native Windows 11 ARM64 validation of CMTrace Open PR 583 and Event Log recovery
knownAcceptanceTraps: PR CI exercises Windows x64 but not native Windows ARM64.
The aggregate ignored live-service command also selects remote-only tests and must not be used on a local-only target.
The real-EVTX suite passes without exercising a file when CMTRACE_EVTX_FIXTURE is unset.
The level-filter ignored test can pass with zero records; manual acceptance requires a nonzero result set.
The time-filter ignored test permits equal result counts; manual acceptance requires observed strict narrowing, while a dataset limitation remains blocked or not exercised.
The packaged provider database is curated and cannot satisfy the retained machine-wide provider database tests.
The ignored native provider capture test deletes its temporary database; the target-private exact-source helper is required for retained-database validation.
No deterministic seam forces EvtSubscribe to polling; record polling as not exercised unless the target naturally returns a documented capability error.
The NSIS bootstrapper is expected to be x86 while the installed application payload must be ARM64.

The exact source reports version 1.5.1 while a newer stable release exists; validate from an isolated snapshot, use CMTRACEOPEN_DISABLE_UPDATE_CHECKS=1 for hash-bound portable artifacts, and independently read back the HKCU installer policy before installed or shell-launched activation.
Saved-filter import/export/favorites/tags/recents management, drag-to-group/pivot, and rule-specific saved-filter colors have no exact-head operator surface and cannot be marked passed.

Automatic execution writes ignored checkout build/dependency output, npm/Cargo/advisory/Playwright account caches, and the evidence root; approved prerequisites and manual app launches also mutate disposable machine/account/profile state.
Every exercised manual gate uses a unique regular raw-artifacts/manual-evidence/<evidenceId>.proof file whose lowercase SHA-256 is recorded; detailed proof never returns.

Private native commands must capture stdout and stderr beneath the evidence root, enforce aggregate byte caps and a bounded owned-process-tree timeout, and never print private output to the shared terminal.
The return ZIP is transport-authenticated only by its outer SHA-256 sent through a trusted out-of-band channel; the adjacent sidecar and internal hashes are not independent trust roots.
A full return uses 33 exact automatic logs and 68 structured manual gates; freeform observations are not returnable.
